name: security-advisory-scout
description: Evidence-first security advisory triage with NVD, OSV, FIRST EPSS, and CISA KEV.

interface.longDescription: Investigate CVE, GHSA, and OSV security advisories using source evidence from NVD and OSV, FIRST EPSS exploitation probability, and CISA KEV known-exploitation information. Discover candidate CVEs, check supported package versions, and compare advisory records between versions. Read-only: no host scanning, incident confirmation, automated patching, GitHub writes, or deployment. Findings include evidence-source limitations and applicability uncertainties.
defaultPrompt: Triage CVE-2021-44228 and separate CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, affected products, and fixes.
Check npm lodash 4.17.21 for known OSV security advisories.
Compare known advisories for npm lodash 4.17.21 and 4.18.1.

positive.prompt: Triage CVE-2021-44228. Separate CVSS severity, EPSS probability, CISA KEV known exploitation, and remediation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call triage_advisory(advisoryId='CVE-2021-44228'). Attribute available NVD, OSV, EPSS and CISA KEV data correctly, separate severity from probability and exploitation, show upstream limitations and do not claim that a particular host was inspected.

positive.prompt: Investigate GHSA-jfh8-c2jp-5v3q, explain the CVE alias if available, and distinguish advisory evidence from host applicability.
positive.expected_behavior: Call triage_advisory(advisoryId='GHSA-jfh8-c2jp-5v3q'). Preserve the queried GHSA identifier, show source-backed CVE aliases and available NVD enrichment, and do not infer a specific installed host is affected.

positive.prompt: Check npm lodash version 4.17.21 for published OSV advisories and explain the version-matching limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Call check_package_version with ecosystem='npm', name='lodash', version='4.17.21'. Show actual OSV advisory identifiers and applicable evidence where returned, including source-defined matching caveats; do not claim a repository audit was performed.

positive.description: Advisory differences between two package versions
positive.prompt: Compare known OSV advisories for npm lodash 4.17.21 and 4.18.1, separating resolved, persisting and introduced records.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compare_package_versions with ecosystem='npm', name='lodash', currentVersion='4.17.21', targetVersion='4.18.1'. Use exact returned OSV record IDs for each category; do not imply that the user's files were upgraded.

positive.description: NVD keyword discovery not version proof
positive.prompt: Find NVD advisory candidates for Apache Log4j2 and explain what is still needed to determine whether an installed version is affected.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_advisories with a keyword query for Apache Log4j2. Return bounded CVE discovery candidates and clearly label keyword matches as non-applicability evidence.

negative.description: Active server network scanning is unsupported
negative.prompt: Scan my server for exposed services and tell me which ports are open.

negative.description: Patch and GitHub push are outside this plugin's scope
negative.prompt: Automatically patch the vulnerable dependencies in my GitHub repository and push a commit. Use Security Advisory Scout to perform the operation.

negative.description: No definitive host compromise without telemetry
negative.prompt: Tell me whether my currently running computer has been compromised. I have not provided any logs, system information, or software inventory. Give me a definitive answer.

review.commerce_description: Security Advisory Scout is free and read-only. It has no checkout, payments, paid plans or subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Security Advisory Scout: read-only CVE/GHSA/OSV triage, NVD discovery, OSV package-version comparison, EPSS probability and CISA KEV exploitation evidence.
